question: Sachin Tendulkar scored his 100th international century against which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sachin Tendulkar scored his 100th international century against Bangladesh on **March 16, 2012**, during the Asia Cup.
 
• This milestone century was achieved at the **Shere Bangla National Stadium** in Mirpur, Dhaka.
 
• Tendulkar's 100th century included **114 runs** off 147 balls, featuring 12 boundaries and 1 six.
 
• With this century, Tendulkar became the first cricketer in history to score **100 international centuries**.
 
• The match ended with Bangladesh winning by 5 wickets, despite Tendulkar's landmark achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar's Career Highlights:**

 
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He holds numerous records in both Test and One-Day International (ODI) cricket, including the most runs in both formats.
 
• He made his international debut for India at the age of 16 in a Test match against Pakistan in Karachi in 1989.
 
• Tendulkar retired from international cricket in 2013, leaving behind a legacy of extraordinary achievements.
 
 
 
• **Asia Cup 2012:**
 
 
• The Asia Cup 2012 was held in Bangladesh from March 11 to March 22.
 
• India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh competed in the tournament.
 
• Pakistan won the Asia Cup 2012, defeating Bangladesh in the final by 2 runs.
 
• Shakib Al Hasan was named the Player of the Series for his all-round performance.
 
 
 
• **Shere Bangla National Stadium:**
 
 
• The Shere Bangla National Stadium is located in Mirpur, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
 
• It is one of the premier cricket venues in Bangladesh, hosting both international and domestic matches.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately 25,000 spectators.
 
• It is named after A.K. Fazlul Huq, a prominent Bengali political leader.
 
 
 
• **Tendulkar's Milestones:**
 
 
• Sachin Tendulkar scored his first international century against England at Old Trafford in 1990.
 
• He is the only player to have scored one hundred international centuries.
 
• He is also the first player to score a double century in an ODI, achieved against South Africa in 2010.
 
• Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 2014.
